children: is evaluating the sale of its Lyric business in a transaction that could value the healthcare software company at about $5 billion.

TPG is working with JPMorgan Chase on a ​potential sale of Lyric, according to a Reuters report on Wednesday, which cited people familiar with the matter. There's no guarantee that any deal will happen.
The company generates about $250 million ​in EBITDA, which typically could put it at ​a valuation of $5 billion considering a 20 times multiple, the people familiar told Reuters.
TPG and JPMorgan declined comment to Reuters. Lyric didn't immediately respond ‌to ⁠a comment request.
TPG purchased ClaimsXten for ~$2.2 billion in 2022 and rebranded it Lyric the following year.
